hook: 字根 ject＝投、擲——想法與物件滿場飛。
script: 反對就 reject 扔回去；意見 inject 注射進去。計劃 project 向前投射，猜測是 conjecture。eject 彈射出去，subject 被扔在權下，object 扔出異議。abject 被扔到最低處，trajectory 是拋物線軌道。

members.speakLineEn: Reviewers may reject a paper for design flaws.
members.speakLineZh: 審查者可能因設計缺陷駁回論文。

members.senseAnchor: of the most contemptible kind; most unfortunate or miserable
members.zhGloss: 悲慘的；下流的；徹底的（貶）
members.speakLineEn: Abject failure forced a redesign of the study.
members.speakLineZh: 徹底慘敗迫使研究重新設計。

members.speakLineEn: Please do not interject until the claim is finished.
A metaphor can become a rhetorical projectile.
members.speakLineZh: 隱喻可能變成修辭拋射物。

reviewHooks: ject＝扔：reject 扔回、inject 注入、project 向前投、eject 彈出
conjecture＝一起投出來的猜測；abject＝被扔到最低
pitfalls: subject 多義：主題／臣民／使遭受——看上下文
project 名詞計畫／動詞投射，詞性要分清
